## What I do

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .expertise-card}
### Microbiome & Viromics
I design and run analyses that turn raw sequencing reads — 16S amplicon, shotgun metagenomic, and viral metagenomic data — into reliable, interpretable pictures of microbial and viral community structure, dynamics, and host interactions.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .expertise-card}
### Bioinformatics Software & Pipelines
I build and maintain open-source tools (e.g. CRESSENT) and workflow pipelines that make specialized analyses reusable, tested, documented, and installable by other researchers — not one-off scripts.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .expertise-card}
### Statistical Analysis & Machine Learning
I apply multivariate statistics, regression, classification, dimensionality reduction, and clustering to high-dimensional biological and environmental data, with attention to study design and validation, not just model fitting.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .expertise-card}
### Reproducible Pipelines & HPC
I implement workflows in Nextflow and Snakemake, containerized with Docker/Apptainer and run on Slurm-managed HPC and research cyberinfrastructure (CyVerse, ACCESS, Tapis), so analyses can be rerun and verified by others.
:::

:::

## Featured projects

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### [CRESSENT](projects/cressent.qmd)
**Problem:** ssDNA viruses (CRESS viruses) lack consistent, reproducible annotation tools.
**Role:** Lead developer.
**Methods:** Python/R, motif & recombination analysis, CLI packaging.
**Impact:** Published open-source toolkit distributed via PyPI/Bioconda ([Microbial Genomics](https://doi.org/10.1099/mgen.0.001632)).

`Python` `R` `PyPI` `Bioconda` `CLI`

[Project details](projects/cressent.qmd) · [Repository](https://github.com/ricrocha82/cressent) · [Publication](https://doi.org/10.1099/mgen.0.001632)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### [VirION3](projects/virion3.qmd)
**Problem:** Short-read-only sequencing struggles to recover complete, accurate viral genomes.
**Role:** Developer, pipeline design.
**Methods:** Long-read (Nanopore/PacBio) + Illumina hybrid assembly, benchmarking.
**Impact:** Extends the VirION/VirION2 line of methods for viral genome recovery.

`Nanopore` `PacBio` `Illumina` `Nextflow`

[Project details](projects/virion3.qmd) · Repository: *link pending*
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### [BATS Diel Virome](projects/bats-diel-virome.qmd)
**Problem:** Viral population dynamics at sub-daily timescales are rarely resolved in marine systems.
**Role:** Co-lead, statistical/bioinformatic analysis.
**Methods:** Time-series viral metagenomics, host prediction, depth-stratified sampling.
**Impact:** Published in [PLOS Biology](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pbio.3003474).

`Metagenomics` `Time-series` `Host prediction`

[Project details](projects/bats-diel-virome.qmd) · [Publication](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pbio.3003474)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### [Pig Burn Wound Microbiome](projects/pig-burn-wound.qmd)
**Problem:** Understanding microbial community succession in a wound-healing model.
**Role:** Bioinformatics analysis (assembly, binning, taxonomy).
**Methods:** Nextflow, metagenomic assembly, genome binning, CheckM2, GTDB-Tk.
**Impact:** Ongoing — generalized methods description (no unpublished results shown).

`Nextflow` `Slurm` `Apptainer` `Metagenomics`

[Project details](projects/pig-burn-wound.qmd)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### [Spinal Cord Injury Microbiome & Virome](projects/sci-microbiome.qmd)
**Problem:** How microbiome, virome, and phage–host dynamics shift after spinal cord injury.
**Role:** Bioinformatics/statistical analysis.
**Methods:** Longitudinal microbiome/virome profiling, mobile-element detection.
**Impact:** Ongoing — generalized methods description.

`Longitudinal` `Microbiome` `Virome`

[Project details](projects/sci-microbiome.qmd)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### [Macquarie Harbour Microbial Ecology](projects/macquarie-harbour.qmd)
**Problem:** How environmental gradients and aquaculture shape microbial communities in a stratified estuary.
**Role:** PhD research — lead.
**Methods:** 16S/18S sequencing, network analysis, machine learning, db-RDA/PERMANOVA.
**Impact:** Multiple peer-reviewed publications (2021–2022).

`R` `Machine Learning` `Ecological Statistics`

[Project details](projects/macquarie-harbour.qmd)
:::
